steps.content: Customers who come to a record store at 3 a.m. are usually crazy, but the owner doesn't seem to care.
The record store owner, who has a phonograph for her head, seems much friendlier than the passersby you encountered earlier. You decide to go in and try your luck.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hello, would it be possible to listen to the records here before buying?

steps.speaker: Record Store Owner
steps.content: You...
You try to make casual conversation, while Nino hides behind your coat, watching nervously.
The owner is startled by you striking up a conversation. When she notices your uniform, she can't help but quiver.

steps.speaker: Record Store Owner
steps.content: Ah... ah yes, you can listen to the ones that are unsealed...

steps.speaker: Record Store Owner
steps.content: There are headphones over there by the listening area... You can ask the staff over there to help, but...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm? But what?
The owner's voice is a bit shaky, but for some reason, that gives you a sense of relief. You can't help but lower your voice a bit more.

steps.speaker: Record Store Owner
steps.content: That staff member is a bit special. If you encounter any difficulties, please don't give her a hard time. You can just come find me.
You nod to the owner and head to the back.
When you reach the listening area, you find several unsealed sample records on the shelf. You pick one at random, put it in the player, and start listening to it through the headphones.
Haunting music echoes in your ears. It sounds like the dreams of a restless sleeper. You know it's an illusion, yet you can't help but believe it's real.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It... shouldn't be this one.
You try a second, then a third... Soon, you've listened to almost all the records on the rack, but still haven't found the one with the eerie voice.
Like the garbled music, your mood once again turns incredibly sour. Without lyrics, you can't defend against the resonance of the radio show, which means... you'll lose your voice.
The words that slip out of your own mouth surprise you. You instinctively tighten your hands over the headphones.
You have some speculation about these anomalies... The Mania here is constantly affecting and assimilating you.
Although those strange people initially wanted to directly "transform" you into the shape of alien heads, they also said that you would eventually transform.
This might mean that, whether or not you're plugged into those electric wires, Mania will eventually assimilate you into a part of this city, just like them.

options: Take a deep breath to calm down.

steps.content: You tilt your head back, close your eyes and breathe deeply, trying to calm yourself down.
But before you can gather your thoughts, the muffled sound of a toppled cargo enters your ears.
You quickly look back to see a human foot sticking out from beside a shelf not far behind you. Someone had fallen there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll go check it out.
You cautiously approach, gripping the pen in your pocket and gently unscrewing the cap.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Excuse me... What happened?
You glance back. The owner is still sitting in front of the counter, propping up her head, listening to the music from the player, nodding along to the beat.
Turning back, you inch towards that unusual shelf.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't move, put down your weapon...
You hold the pen, pointing its sharp tip outwards, only to see... something unexpected. It's not a trap, nor a crime scene.
A woman, a "normal person" like you, is lying on the ground. The scattered records around her make her look like a pale blue stylus.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Wow! Another normal person!!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But is she... all right?
You pick up the records on the ground and examine the woman on the floor. Her shoulders are gently rising and falling. She seems to be asleep.
There's small dark circles under her eyes, and her eyebrows are slightly furrowed. She looks like someone who had just finished a shift and dozed off.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is she an employee here?
You hand the record to Nino, observing as you gently tap the woman's shoulder.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're tired, go get some proper rest. Don't sleep on the ground, okay?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss, do you need my help?
Mmm...
Your calls only elicit a faint murmur from the woman. She doesn't move at all.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Is she... really that tired?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She must've been working non-stop for several days and then suddenly ended up in a place like this. Her body must've instinctively fallen into a deep sleep to escape reality after the double blow from psychological and physical stress.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You sound as if you've experienced the same thing...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But... if what the owner says is true, and she's an employee here, she should be working, right?
Nino squats down to look at the pretty girl.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Sleeping at work... she'd get her wages deducted...
Mmm... Emm...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Huh? She woke up?
As if triggered by some key word, the slumbering lady slowly wakes up. After seeing the situation in front of her, she jumps up in fright.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are... are you okay?
The woman looks at you in surprise, her mouth slightly ajar. She looks at you, then at Nino, then back at you, then back at Nino again.

steps.speaker: Startled Woman
steps.content: Emm!
The woman rushes over to pat your face and pinch your hand, as if to confirm if you're real.
After she's done pinching you, she turns to Nino and pinches her all over, too. Then, as if relieved, she pulls Nino into her embrace.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Mmph...! Miss... I can't... can't breathe...
The woman quickly lets go of Nino and bows apologetically.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You are...?
The woman searches her pockets for a while, then pulls out a comms device and starts typing in front of you.
You and Nino look at each other, not knowing what she wants.
After a bit, she hands the comms device to you. There are two short lines of words on the screen.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Hello, my name is Eleven, silent E at the top. Sorry, I got a bit excited when I finally saw people like me..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "But for some reason, I can't speak. I can only communicate with you in this way."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just now, I think I heard... the opening line of a radio show around here...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's your relationship with that radio show?
The woman seems at a loss to your question. She runs to the shelf, rummages around, then pulls out a pure white record with only a few numbers marked on it.
She runs to the listening area, puts the record into the player, and hands you the headphones.
"Hel...Hello... Welcome to Call... at 3 AM... Eh..."
When you listen, you realize it's indeed the opening line of "Call at 3 AM"! But some of the words have been cut, making it sound quite disjointed.
It's the same strange voice you heard outside the record store.

You look at the timid woman in front of you. Your eyebrows furrow slightly. No matter who she is, as someone who has already lost her voice and is linked to the radio station, she might be the key to leaving this world.
